items.label: MATERIALS
items.value: Vegan (PU) saffiano crosshatch textured leather with gold-tone hardware

items.label: POCKETS
items.value: 1 internal zipper pocket, 2 internal slip pockets, 1 center zipper pocket, multi pockets to keep your daily essentials conveniently in check, wallet: 3 compartment, 1 zipper pouch, 8 card slots

items.label: SIZES
items.value: 14.5"W x 11"H x 4"D, handle drop: 4.7"; Detachable shoulder strap 40", fit tablet, book, wallet, and other daily essentials, wristlet: 9.5"H x 6.5"W

items.label: DESIGN
items.value: Slim structured with trendy cut-out hinged handles, flat bottom with studs, zipper closure, matching wristlet. Shoulder strap is a great addition. Perfect for dating,shopping,working,traveling, vocation etc

items.label: Maintenance
items.value: Regular maintenance can keep it in beautiful condition. If you spill something on it, just wipe it clean with a damp cloth and let the bag dry in a well-aired place. Great for everyday use and travelling and will always look pretty.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe clean with a damp cloth if spilled on. Let dry in a well-aired place. Regular maintenance recommended. Suitable for everyday use and traveling.
